info.name: School Management - Teacher APK API
info.description:
Teacher APK backend, organised exactly like the app: an ⌂ App bar (top-right 🔔 notifications + 👤 profile) and 5 bottom-nav tabs — Home · Classes · Attendance · Notices · Profile.

Safe Pickup is NOT a tab: it lives under the Profile tab ("12 - Pickup"), is shown only to class teachers (GET /me -> isClassTeacher), and is the deep-link target for pickup notifications.

baseUrl points straight at platform-service (default http://localhost:5002); no /api/v1/platform prefix (the api-gateway on :8080 adds it). Collection-level Bearer {{accessToken}}.

RUN ORDER: "00 - Environment / Health" -> "Tab 5 · Profile / 01 - Auth / Login (teacher)" (stores accessToken/teacherId/schoolId) -> "App bar / 👤 Profile menu / Me" (stores isClassTeacher + classTeacherSectionId) -> "Tab 2 · Classes / 03 - Classes" top-to-bottom.

item.name: ⌂ App bar  (top-right: 🔔 notifications · 👤 profile)
item.description: The two icons in the top-right of every screen. Bell -> notifications list + unread badge. Avatar -> quick menu (Me / My Profile / Logout).

item.name: 📱 Tab 1 · Home  (/teacher/home)
item.description: Bottom-nav "Home". Today at a glance + the announcements feed.

item.name: 📱 Tab 2 · Classes  (/teacher/classes)
item.description: Bottom-nav "Classes". Roster + everything you do for a class: timetable, homework, assignments, study material, exams & marks.

exec: // a timetable period carries classId/sectionId/subjectId — use it to fill any
// vars the Classes folder did not set (e.g. subjectId, which has no list endpoint).
const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.id) pm.environment.set('materialId', d.id);

item.name: 📱 Tab 3 · Attendance  (/teacher/attendance)
item.description: Bottom-nav "Attendance". Daily marking (idempotent), finalize, history, summary, per-student log.

item.name: Submit again same key (must NOT duplicate)
📱 Tab 4 · Notices  (/teacher/notices)
item.description: School announcements the teacher receives (read + mark-read). Authoring is admin-side.

item.name: 📱 Tab 5 · Profile  (/teacher/profile)
item.description: Bottom-nav "Profile". Account: sign-in/out & password, profile & documents, leave requests, office messages.

item.name: 12 - Pickup  (class-teacher only)
item.description: Pickup is not a bottom-nav tab — it opens from the Profile tab and is shown only when GET /me returns isClassTeacher:true. It is also the deep-link target for pickup push notifications. Staging OTP = 123456.

exec: pm.test("non class teacher -> empty pickup list", () => d.length === 0);
pm.test("rows carry pickup flags", () => d.every(r => 'pickupEnabled' in r && 'hasGuardianMobile' in r && 'alreadyPickedUpToday' in r));
pm.test("no raw otp / phone", () => !('otpHash' in d) && !('guardianMobile' in d));

item.name: 🔒 Security & Error Tests  (not a tab)
item.description: Cross-tenant / wrong-role / bad-input assertions — run after the tabs above.
